scenarios.name: public_web_cli_search_and_read_article
scenarios.title: Use the CLI to search Wikipedia and open the matching article
scenarios.workflow: Launch -> open Wikipedia -> locate search -> type real keys -> click submit without movement -> wait for article -> inspect and capture
scenarios.user_problem: An agent must be able to use headless mode and no-move clicks on a public website through independent CLI processes, then verify the destination page.

steps.description: Launch a fresh browser and open the public search page
Type the query into the discovered search input using keyboard events
raw_code: assert typed['typed'] and typed['verified'] and typed['methods_tried'][0] == 'keys', typed

location = cli('js_evaluate', '--port', port, '--expression', "(() => { const e=document.querySelector('button[type=submit]'); e.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); const x=r.x+r.width/2,y=r.y+r.height/2; return {x,y,hit:e.contains(document.elementFromPoint(x,y)),query:document.getElementById('searchInput').value}; })()")['result']
assert location['hit'] and location['query'] == 'Google Chrome', location

steps.description: Submit with no-move and wait for the article to become visible
raw_code: assert 'Google Chrome' in state['heading'] and 'Google Chrome' in state['title'] and 'Chrome' in state['text'], state

steps.description: Save the observed article and screenshot for visual review
raw_code: (tmp_path / 'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps({'navigation': navigation, 'typed': typed, 'clicked': clicked, 'article': state, 'screenshot': shot}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

scenarios.name: public_web_extension_menu_survives_worker_restart
scenarios.title: Use the real extension to expand a public site's menu and continue after worker restart
scenarios.workflow: Open Wikipedia -> scroll to language menu -> trusted click -> verify expansion -> restart worker -> reacquire button -> collapse -> inspect and capture
scenarios.user_problem: An extension driver must deliver trusted clicks to visible controls on a public site, and recover the same tab and page state after its worker restarts.

steps.description: Open Wikipedia through the real extension and identify the owned tab
raw_code: # Activate only our isolated automation tab so Chrome advances UI animations.

steps.description: Scroll the control into view and confirm the click will hit it
raw_code: locate = "(() => { const e=document.getElementById('js-lang-list-button'); e.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); const x=r.x+r.width/2,y=r.y+r.height/2; return {x,y,width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,hit:e.contains(document.elementFromPoint(x,y)),expanded:e.getAttribute('aria-expanded')}; })()"
assert location['expanded'] == 'false' and location['hit'] and 0 < location['x'] < location['width'] and 0 < location['y'] < location['height'], location
assert await live_extension.call(mouse_click, x=location['x'], y=location['y'], move=False) is True
# The site keeps a 1000s visibility transition alive; wait for its visual size/transform transitions.
assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'Menu animation did not settle'

steps.description: Restart the worker and verify the same tab and expanded page survive
raw_code: assert after['mainTabId'] == before['mainTabId'] and after['autoTabs'] == before['autoTabs'] and after['mainTabId'] in after['attached'], (before, after)

steps.description: Reacquire the current coordinates and use another trusted click to collapse the menu
raw_code: assert await live_extension.call(mouse_click, x=location['x'], y=location['y'], move=False) is True
assert collapsed['expanded'] == 'false' and collapsed['clicks'] == [True, True] and collapsed['url'] == expanded['url'], collapsed
# The site keeps a 1000s visibility transition alive; wait for its visual size/transform transitions.
assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'Menu animation did not settle'
(tmp_path / 'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps({'before': before, 'expanded': expanded, 'afterRestart': after, 'collapsed': collapsed}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
